arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel

translations.en.sahih: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan bagaimana Tuhanmu telah bertindak terhadap tentara bergajah?

transliteration: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

translations.en.sahih: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
translations.en.pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
translations.en.yusufali: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Dia telah menjadikan tipu daya mereka (untuk menghancurkan Ka'bah) itu sia-sia?

translations.en.sahih: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
translations.en.pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
translations.en.yusufali: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Dia mengirimkan kapada mereka burung yang berbondong-bondong,

transliteration: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

translations.en.sahih: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
translations.en.pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
translations.en.yusufali: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
translations.id.indonesian: yang melempari mereka dengan batu (berasal) dari tanah yang terbakar,

translations.en.sahih: And He made them like eaten straw.
translations.en.pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
translations.en.yusufali: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
translations.id.indonesian: lalu Dia menjadikan mereka seperti daun-daun yang dimakan (ulat).
